housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 crowdsourced average of EUR 1,527.37 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Leiden city centre.

banking.summary: ABN AMRO requires identification, a BSN, proof of a Dutch residential address, and income evidence unless opening only a savings account.
required_docs: valid passport, accepted identity card, Dutch driving licence, or residence permit
Dutch address evidence such as a BRP extract
income evidence such as an employment contract, three consecutive payslips, or a benefit statement unless opening only a savings account

schools.summary: International School Leiden offers international primary education using the IEYC and IPC curricula.

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer staying more than four months must register in person with Leiden municipality and schedule the registration within five days of moving.
legal_admin.registration_step: Schedule an appointment and register in person with the municipality of Leiden within five days of moving; eligible accompanying family members must attend.

tax_finance.summary: The Dutch individual tax and government identifier is the Citizen Service Number (BSN), issued when a newcomer registers with a Dutch municipality.

transport.summary: Qbuzz publishes Leiden regional, R-net, local, and city bus routes.
